summary: 10.0.34.13 Enterprise Release - Full Desktop Parity for Matching Workspace, Native Drive CSV Import, Pre-Reversal Delete Impact Analysis, Cross-Module Deep Linking, and Branding Binary Uploads
highlights: 1. Matching Workspace Engine (Desktop BankStatementController.java:680-776 Parity): 6 live KPI cards (Bank Amount, Allocated, Round-off, Bank Remaining, Doc Residual, Settlement Status), 10-column candidate table with checkboxes, confidence scores, and editable allocation inputs with rounding tolerance calculation and partial settlement confirmation

2. Native Drive CSV Selection & Master Account Resolution: Direct file chooser without mock popups, Kotak/Standard CSV parser, automated account matching, and choice dialog modal for master data bank account mapping
3. Two-Phase Pre-Reversal Delete Impact Analysis: Safety modal with Phase 1 pre-reversal impact metric preview (transactions, matched, expenses, ignored) and Phase 2 uppercase 'DELETE' verification
4. Cross-Module Deep-Linking & Re-Entrancy Guard: Unified openLinkedDocument for PRC-, EXP-, BANK-, INV-, and PO- records with NavigationRouter re-entrancy prevention guard

5. Dedicated Note Updates & Context Menu Parity: POST /api/bank-statements/transactions/{id}/note endpoint integration allowing note edits on matched records without status mutation; neutral secondary Actions dropdown with strict status-based action categorization
6. Purchase Recon & Recon Supplier Actions: Desktop Actions dropdown with View, Edit, direct Open Bank Statement navigation, and dependency deletion protection

7. Server-Resource Branding Binary Upload & Email Test Guard: Raw binary PUT /api/authority/resources/BUSINESS_ASSET/{key} with server-resource: pointer resolution and empty-password safe email testing
8. DOM Structural Integrity: Closed orphaned container in Business Settings restoring full access to Security and Module Management tabs
